desc: Prove the necessary and sufficient prefix-cut condition for strong connectivity of a directed path augmented by white-to-black matching edges.
Derive an efficient exact counting formula via the black/white-rank permutation formulation, and validate it against exhaustive small-N enumeration.
Develop an efficient combinatorial counting algorithm for all valid pairings, targeting \(O(N \log N)\).
Implement the final algorithm in Python with modulo \(998244353\), including input parsing and stdout output.
